source_facts: Two panels, three named left rays, three extended joins through their origins, and five right ray depictions.
The geometric labels are the A/B pairs with left subscripts 1, 2, 3, plus A and B on one right ray.
Ray origins carry dark markers; the B-labelled terminal strokes have no clearly separate point discs.
Left rays run up-right; right rays run down-right. Each panel has its own parallel ray bundle.
Left auxiliary joins are shared full supports through origin pairs, including one unlabelled crossing with the middle ray.
No coincident/nested ray pair is visible in either panel; support coincidence at a point is incidence, not line coincidence.
There are no ray arrowheads, metric annotations, axes, lattice, enclosing set boundary or printed figure number inside this PNG.
The raw prose identifies panel a with the same-direction equivalence relation and panel б with one direction as an entire equivalence class.
glyph_qualifications: A1/B1, A2/B2, A3/B3 are normalized transcriptions of italic printed labels with subscripts, corroborated by raw prose, not a claim of pixel-perfect modern typesetting.
The left panel label is a-like; its exact Latin/Cyrillic Unicode identity cannot be established from this glyph alone.
The right panel glyph is Cyrillic-be-like and agrees with raw prose б; it must not silently be treated as a geometric point label or Latin b.
